speaker: AQUANAUTILUS
text: Bubble curtains can reduce the amount of construction noise reaching the surrounding marine environment.

speaker: AQUANAUTILUS
text: They provide a reliable way to reduce the disturbance to fish and marine mammals.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: This is a well-established and comparatively predictable approach.

speaker: ENERGY MINISTER
text: However, installing and operating the system will increase construction costs.

speaker: AQUANAUTILUS
text: It also does not eliminate the disturbance completely.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: Nevertheless, the technology provides greater certainty and is consistent with the precautionary approach to environmental protection.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: Bubble curtains provide a reliable contribution to SDG 14, but they are more costly and do not reduce the environmental impact as much as the more experimental alternative.
